home.title: Fantasy football
home.metaDescription: Fantasy football tools: a guided auction with ratings from 1 to 100 on starting chances, bonuses, performance, maluses, physical reliability and club, computed over three seasons.
home.intro: A guided auction and a recommended lineup every week. You set up the league, record the purchases, and from there the site works for you.
home.auctionText: Set credits, participants, Classic or Mantra squad, rules and modifiers. Then the player list with ratings, estimated fantasy average, recommended credits and the purchases board.
home.lineupText: Every week, the recommended lineup for each of your teams: formation, eleven and ordered bench, computed on real starting chances, injuries, official lineups and the match forecast. Squads come on their own from the auctions.

auction.title: Auction
auction.metaDescription: Fantasy football auction with ratings from 1 to 100 for every player: starting chances, bonuses, performance, maluses, reliability and club, with recommended credits.
auction.intro: Ratings from 1 to 100: last season is the base, the current one weighs a quarter after three matchdays and passes half in January, the one two years ago weighs little. The club counts too: how much it creates and concedes (expected goals) and where it is expected to finish. A player's or club's start is a rating of its own. The credits are live: record the purchases (yours and the others') and the prices adapt to the money left, the top players left and what the table is paying; with a strategy on you also see your maximum bid.
auction.empty: Player list not available right now: the database is responding slowly or the squads have not been imported yet. Try again in a few minutes.
auction.resetConfirm: Delete the settings and purchases of this auction?

setup.cupsCountHint: On: ratings, starting chances and bonuses also take Coppa Italia, the Supercup and the European cups into account (cups weigh half in starting chances). Off: only each country's main league counts.

toolbar.title: Your auction
toolbar.text: Here is the league with mode, participants and credits. The buttons: the weekly lineup, saving in the account (so the auction follows you on every device), the import from Leghe Fantacalcio, the settings.

status.title: Always in sight
status.text: This bar stays put while you scroll: the credits you have left, the places filled per role, the strategy in use and the last purchase, which you can undo with a tap.

strategy.title: Pick a strategy
strategy.text: Tap here and choose how to spend the credits (balanced, strong attack, defence block...). The strategy gives you the targets, the ceiling for each and the plan B if someone snatches him. You can build your own too.

table.title: The table
table.text: The other participants with credits left and free places per role: you know who can still raise. Tap a name to see their squad.

filters.title: Find a player
filters.text: Search by name or club (Enter buys the first result), filter by role, club and tier, hide the bought ones. The Tiers view groups the list by level.

list.title: The player list
list.text: For every player the total rating out of 100, the recommended credits, your strategy's ceiling and the status: Take him, Fair price, Pricey, Leave him. Tap the row for the details, the star to want or exclude him, Buy to record who takes him and for how much, for any team at the table. The "?" at the top right lists the keyboard shortcuts.

roster.title: Your squad and targets
roster.text: Squad: who you took, by role, with the credits spent and the team's rating. Targets: who the strategy recommends now, with the plan B for each and the contested places. They update with every purchase at the table.

strategies.title: Recommended strategies
strategies.intro: Every strategy is simulated on the player list with the recommended credits: you see how it splits the budget, who it would buy and what the resulting lineup is worth. "Use" sets the budgets per role in your squad and marks the targets on the list.
strategies.hint: The XI value is the sum of the estimated fantasy averages of the best eleven weighted by their chance of playing, in the formation that yields most among the seven classic ones (3-4-3, 4-3-3, 3-5-2, 4-4-2, 4-5-1, 5-3-2, 5-4-1): when a starter does not play the reserve of his role counts, so a squad without cover pays. With the defence modifier on, formations with four or five defenders also count the estimated bonus. If two formations are worth almost the same (within 2%) the strategy's natural one wins. Targets and formation change as players get bought: every strategy restarts from what you already have in the squad, so you can switch at any point of the auction.
strategies.needsDefence: It needs the defence modifier in the settings
strategies.ignored: Ignored: the strategies do not suggest him

prefs.title: Your constraints
prefs.empty: No constraint: the strategies choose the targets. You can pin a player or ignore him from his row on the list, or with the × below.
prefs.hint: A pinned player goes in every strategy's plan at the current price, in the largest slot of his role; an ignored one is never suggested. The rest of the plan adapts.

balanced.name: Balanced
balanced.tagline: No gaps, a good starter in every role
balanced.description: Classic split of the credits (7-17-28-48). In every department a top player and reliable starters behind, without breaking the bank for anyone. The safest choice when you know little about the opponents or when the list has no isolated stars.

topPerRole.name: One top per department
topPerRole.tagline: The best of every role, then starter fillers
topPerRole.description: About half of every role's budget goes on a single player (two in attack), the rest on cheap starters. It wins when the list's top players are really a cut above the others: you pay for the sure bonus and save on the gambles.

strongMidfield.name: Strong midfield
strongMidfield.tagline: The bulk of the budget on midfielders with bonuses
strongMidfield.description: Almost half of the credits on midfielders who score and assist and on penalty takers, second-level attack, low-cost defence and goalkeeper. It works in leagues where bonus midfielders are few and everyone undervalues them at the auction.

topAttack.name: Top attack
topAttack.tagline: Two or three elite forwards, the rest on the cheap
topAttack.description: Two thirds of the credits in attack: the first two or three forwards of the list, then a defence and midfield of cheap starters. High risk, high reward: if a top player gets injured you pay dearly, if they stay fit you decide many matchdays on your own.

defenceBlock.name: Defence block + goalkeeper
defenceBlock.tagline: Defenders of the same club and a top goalkeeper
defenceBlock.description: With the defence modifier on, it invests in a goalkeeper and high-rated defenders of the clubs that concede little, preferring the defenders of the chosen goalkeeper's club (the block). Solid attack but not top. The modifier adds points every matchday even without bonuses.

threeStars.name: Three stars
threeStars.tagline: Two forwards and an elite midfielder, then savings
threeStars.description: About 85% of the credits on three players: the two best forwards you can get, paid almost the same, and the midfielder with the most bonuses. Everything else cheap starters. It holds if the three stars stay fit: in leagues with many teams it is the strategy that makes the biggest difference at the end of the season.

penaltyTakers.name: Penalty takers and sure bonuses
penaltyTakers.tagline: Who takes the penalties and who guarantees goals and assists
penaltyTakers.description: Priority to penalty takers and to players with steady bonuses over the last two years, even if they are not the most famous names. A penalty taker is worth 6-10 goals a season regardless of form: with 8-10 teams at the table they usually cost less than they yield.

safeStarters.name: All starters
safeStarters.description: Flat spend: no player above 15-20% of the budget, only regular starters with good physical reliability and rating-to-price ratio. A deep squad that does not suffer injuries and suspensions; it loses something in top-end bonuses but the lineup is always complete.

youngUpside.name: Rising youngsters
youngUpside.tagline: Under-25 starters, low prices and room to grow
youngUpside.description: Preference for youngsters who already hold a starting place and for 23-25-year-olds who have stepped up: they cost less than veterans with the same rating and tend to improve during the season. To pair with one or two top players so you are not left without bonuses.

strategies.formationAutoHint: Auto: every strategy picks the formation that yields most with the squad it buys. Choose a formation and the plans buy the starters of that formation, moving credits towards the departments with more starters.
strategies.formationFixed: Formation {formation}: the plans pay for the starters of this formation plus one reserve per department, the other places at one credit. The XI value is computed in this formation.

optimized.name: Optimised on the list
optimized.tagline: The credit split that buys the best eleven on this list
optimized.description: The other strategies have their credit split decided in advance; this one searches for it on the real list at today's prices: it tries dozens of splits between the roles and keeps the one that buys the most valuable lineup, restarting from what you already have in the squad. It changes during the auction along with the prices. No preference on profiles: only the numbers count.

tiers.title: Tiers
tiers.hint: Seven tiers per role by total rating: the number of players in each tier follows how many your league buys (participants × slots), from Top to Fifth, the last tier a league really buys. Whoever has little data behind him cannot sit in Top or Semi-top: he drops one tier. Below the bought tiers: Wildcards are the gambles with upside (youngsters with bonuses, flying starts, new signings with good numbers but few matches), Avoid whoever has a long injury or never plays, Fillers everyone else.

lineup.title: Recommended lineup
lineup.metaDescription: Recommended formation and eleven for the matchday: real starting chances, official lineups, injuries and the match forecast for every player in your squad.
lineup.intro: The lineup for the next league matchday, and only for that one: every week it updates with official lineups, absences and match forecasts. The teams are the ones saved from your auctions, one per fantasy league: you switch team here, without touching the auction.
lineup.noPool: Player list not available right now. Try again in a few minutes.
lineup.noMatchday: Fixtures not available for this league: the recommended lineup works with a single country's league.
lineup.emptyRoster: {team} has no players in the squad: record the purchases on the auction board.
lineup.short: {count, plural, one {# player missing} other {# players missing}} to complete the formation: the squad is short in one role.
lineup.benchHint: The whole squad outside the eleven, in the order to put them on the bench: by role, the most valuable first. The first of each role comes in for a starter without a rating.
lineup.colPlaysHint: Chance of getting a rating: as a starter or coming on with enough minutes. Official lineup if published, otherwise absences, use in the club's latest matches and the auction's starting chances. Hover for the split.
lineup.colRatingHint: Expected base rating, adjusted for the match: at home, opponent, chance of winning.
lineup.colPointsHint: Expected fantasy score if he plays: rating plus expected bonuses and maluses, with the goals forecast for his club (and conceded, for goalkeepers).
lineup.colValueHint: What the slot is worth if you field him: expected fantasy score as a starter times the chance of starting, plus the points as a substitute (rating 6 and a share of the bonuses) times the chance of coming on, plus the role's first reserve when he is left without a rating. It is the order of the lineup.
lineup.formationsHint: Expected points of every formation with the squad. Tap a formation to field it anyway; tap again to go back to the recommended one. The league's formation is chosen if it is within 2% of the best.
lineup.fixtureMine: {count, plural, one {# of yours} other {# of yours}}, {starting} on the pitch
lineup.how1: Plays: with the official lineup (published about an hour before) a starter is worth 95%, a bench player 3% to start and 22% to get a rating coming on, whoever is out 2%. Before that, current injuries and suspensions count, then how the club used him in its last eight matches (recent ones weigh more: matches as a starter and as a substitute kept apart) and the auction's starting chances.
lineup.how2: Rating: everything is on the Fantacalcio rating scale (a starter's average around 6, not the provider's 6.9). The provider's ratings are translated into ratings per role with a line fitted on the official Fantacalcio.it ratings as soon as there are enough, before that with the distribution of the last two seasons. The real average is pulled towards his latest ratings (the official ones when there are any; up to 40% with five matches), then shifted by the match: a third of a point between a sure win and a sure defeat (the club's strength against the opponent, as the forecast sees it), a fifth for the form of the last five against the opponent's, a bit more at home. Goalkeepers and defenders go up against a weak attack and down against a strong one.
lineup.how3: Bonus: the player's goals and assists per match, pulled towards what he did in his last five outings (up to a third, with enough minutes), then scaled on how much his club is expected to score in this match against a normal match of the club (the club's attacking strength from xG and goals, stabilised on the few matches of the early season), with a wider lever: a big club against a small one is worth up to +80%, the opposite up to -50%. Malus: cards per match go up for whoever risks losing (up to +30%) and away from home, down for the favourite. For goalkeepers the goals expected from the opponent and the chance of a clean sheet count. Cups in or out as in the league settings.
lineup.how4: Formation: for every formation the values of the eleven are added up, plus the cover of the first reserve when a starter risks getting no rating. A better but slightly less certain player goes ahead of a safer but weaker one, because if he is missing the reserve comes in, not zero.
lineup.how5: Defence modifier: estimated from the expected ratings of goalkeeper and defenders, weighted by how sure it is that they play.

lineup.colGoalsHint: Expected goals: his club - the opponent. For goalkeepers and defenders the second number counts, for the others the first.
lineup.colFactorHint: How much the match moves his bonuses against a normal match of the club. For goalkeepers, the chance of a clean sheet.
lineup.legendHint: Hover over a number for the explanation; the "?" button next to the name opens every reason.
lineup.colSignalsHint: Only what counts: green in favour, red against. Hover over a signal for the numbers, the "?" opens every reason.
lineup.colRecentHint: Average of his latest ratings (up to five matches played) and how many: the official Fantacalcio ratings when loaded, otherwise the provider's ratings brought onto the rating scale. Green above his season average, red below. It moves the expected rating up to 40%, more with more matches.
lineup.lockedNoChange: The matchday has started: the lineup is locked

locked.title: Lineup locked.
locked.text: The matchday started {deadline}: from then on no league lets you change. This is the recommended lineup as it was at {savedAt}, the last view before kick-off. It unlocks with the next matchday.
locked.fresh: The matchday started {deadline} and you had not opened the page before: the recommended lineup was computed now, with today's data, and stays this one until the next matchday.

lineup.how8: Matchday: the recommended lineup is the one of the matchday in play until its last match is over, then it moves to the next. Lock: at the matchday's first kick-off the recommended lineup freezes as it was at the last opening of the page before the whistle (pins and KOs included) and no longer changes until the next matchday. Open the page shortly before the start to have the latest news in.

lineup.whyHint: Why: every reason behind this player's numbers

A penalty wide or off the post is only a malus for the taker: the goalkeeper's bonus is there only if he saves it.

recap.voteHint: Everything you see here is about this matchday's match only (under every name is which one). Type the newspaper rating (not the fantasy score) for whoever has finished the match: the site adds bonuses and maluses with your league's rules. No rating: type sv (or 0). Empty field: back to the site's estimate. With the pencil you correct goals, assists, cards, penalties and own goals. The ratings entered calibrate the rating scale and the latest performances used by the advice.
recap.voteShort: Type the newspaper rating of whoever has finished; sv = no rating; empty = the site's estimate.
recap.resetConfirm: Delete every rating and correction entered for this matchday, on this device and in the account?

tour.open: Replay the step-by-step guide of the lineup

team.title: Your team
team.text: Choose which squad to field for: the teams come on their own from the auctions you recorded or imported. Next to it the league's mode and the fixed formation, if any.

status.title: The matchday
status.text: When it is played and when the lineup locks (at the start of the matchday it stays fixed as it was). The counter says for how many of your clubs the official lineups are out, and the time of the last update.

fixtures.title: Your players' matches
fixtures.text: The matches of the matchday in which your players play, with time, forecast and how many of yours are in. Tap a match for the analysis.

pitch.title: The recommended eleven
pitch.text: The formation and the eleven that yield most according to real starting chances, official lineups, injuries and the match forecast. Tap a player for the why, the pin to lock him on the pitch, the ban to exclude him. Drag a bench player over a starter to swap them.

bench.title: The bench
bench.text: Ordered the right way: the first comes in first. From here you drag a player onto the pitch, or tap the arrows and choose who goes out, or "in the best place" and the model decides.

pins.title: Your choices
pins.text: The summary of who you locked, excluded or sent to the bench by hand, and what it costs you against the free lineup. "Undo everything" removes it all and goes back to the model's advice.

starters.title: The starters' numbers
starters.text: For every starter the chance of playing, the expected points and the signals behind them (official, contested place, injury, easy or hard match). The total at the top is what the model expects from the eleven.

formations.title: The other formations
formations.text: Every formation rated on your squad, the best at the top. Tap a formation to impose it: the eleven is rebuilt on it.

how.title: How it works
how.text: Here you find in short how the advice is built: what weighs, when it updates and what happens at the matchday's lock.

liveScore.title: Live score
liveScore.text: From the moment the matchday starts, here you see the points of the locked lineup match by match: who has finished, who is on the pitch with the minute, who still has to play. Ratings estimated from the provider's rating until the official ones arrive; substitutions from the bench kick in at full time.

liveScore.title: Live score · matchday {round}
liveScore.officialHint: The official ratings of this matchday are loaded: the points are the real ones, with bonuses and maluses by your league's rules.
liveScore.estimateHint: The lineup is the one locked at the start of the matchday. For every player the rating is the provider's rating brought onto the rating scale, updated minute by minute while the match is in play; goals, assists, cards, penalties and goals conceded come from the provider. The automatic substitutions (same role, bench order) kick in only when the starter's match has finished without a rating. With the official ratings the score becomes the real one.

votes.intro: Type the app's newspaper rating (not the fantasy score) for whoever took the pitch. Empty = the site's estimate. "sv" = no rating. Enter moves to the next.
votes.unavailable: The season's data is not available right now. Try again shortly.
votes.uploadHint: The Excel file of the ratings from Fantacalcio.it / Leghe Fantacalcio (Voti_Fantacalcio_Stagione_..._Giornata_N.xlsx) for the selected matchday. It fills the fields: then Save.

votes.signInHint: The ratings are saved in the administrator's account: sign in with it from the menu at the top right.

model.title: How accurate the model is
model.metaDescription: The ratings entered by users against the site's estimate from the provider's rating: average gap by role and by rating band.
model.intro: Every rating entered by the administrator in Newspaper ratings becomes a comparison between the real rating and the one the site would have estimated from the provider's rating. Here you see where the estimate is high or low, by role and by rating band, over every player rated by every user.
model.empty: No rating entered yet: from the admin panel, in Newspaper ratings, the ratings of a matchday are entered.
model.totalsHint: Average gap = real rating minus the estimate with the starting scale (positive: the site estimates low). Average error = the difference in absolute value. Calibrated error = the same with the scale learnt from the ratings, the one the advice uses today.
model.byRoleHint: With fewer than {min} comparisons per role the scale only shifts the level (green within ±0.10, yellow within ±0.25); from {min} up the whole line is recomputed.
model.byBandHint: If the gap changes sign between bands, the slope of the scale is wrong, not just the level: it happens when the newspaper ratings compress the high or low ratings.
model.how1: The model does not predict the rating out of nothing: it translates the provider's rating (1-10 scale, average 6.9 for a starter) onto the newspaper rating scale (average about 6). This page measures that translation.
model.how2: Bonuses and maluses (goals, assists, cards) do not enter here: they come from the provider and are right when its data is.
model.how3: The more ratings you enter, the closer the scale gets to the real newspaper ratings. At least 120 comparisons per role are needed for the site to recompute the whole line: before that only the level moves, cautiously.

trade.title: Transfer market
trade.open: Transfer window: trades between teams and releases with a refund
trade.tradeHint: Choose the two teams and tick the players each gives away. The players move at the cost they had; the balance in credits is recorded in the movements. The trade goes through only if both squads stay within the places per role and with at least one credit for every free place.
trade.tradeShort: Tick who each gives away; the players move at their cost, the balance goes in the movements.
trade.releaseShort: Choose player and refund: he goes back on the list, the difference stays among the credits spent.

issues.empty: Tick at least one player on one side.
issues.same: The two teams must be different.
issues.notOwned: {manager} does not have {name} in the squad.
issues.credits: {manager} would be left with {left} credits: not enough for the free places.

trade.releaseHint: Release a player with the refund your league gives: the price paid, half of it, the quotation or any amount. The player goes back on the list and the difference between price and refund stays among the credits spent.
trade.ledgerHint: The credits moved outside the purchases: trade balances and refund differences. Added to each team's credits left.

import.title: Import the squads from Leghe Fantacalcio
import.cardTitle: Already held the auction on Leghe Fantacalcio?
import.cardText: Export the squads from the league (Export squads, CSV file) and upload them here: every team comes in within a minute, yours is ready for the recommended lineup.
import.intro: On Leghe Fantacalcio: Squads → Export squads. Choose the downloaded file or paste its content. The players are recognised by the code of the Fantacalcio.it list.
import.paste: Or paste the text of the file
import.yourTeamHint: Select your team: the recommended lineup starts from this one. The others feed prices, targets and strategies.
import.creditsHint: Those of your league: needed to compute the credits left. Suggested from what the team that spent most has spent.
import.unmatchedHint: {count, plural, =1 {1 player is not on the site's list} other {# players are not on the site's list}} (sold abroad or code not on the list): he stays out of the squad, you can add him by hand from the auction.
import.replaceConfirm: There is already an auction on the device: the import replaces it (the one saved to the cloud stays). Continue?
import.error: Cannot read the file: it must be the Leghe Fantacalcio export ($,$,$ blocks with team, code and price).
